title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in PI Web Solution…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Product Enquiry for WooCommerce plugin, affecting versions up to 2.2.34.64. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts. The flaw is identified as CWE-79 and has a CVSS v3.1 score of 7.1, indicating a high severity level.
